title: 应急预案与应急准备
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/155_应急预案与应急准备.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/155_应急预案与应急准备/src.py

points.K5: 应急电话和处置卡上墙
points.K7: 应急物资定点放定期查

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一本应急预案手册和一个急救箱
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank emergency plan binder in one paw and a first aid kit in the other, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第14章第一课：应急预案与应急准备。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起手指，身后是一个问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger, a big question mark floating behind it.
shots.narration: 出了事怎么办？要在出事前想好。

shots.scene: 阿杰第一周进实验室，小研突然发问
shots.prompt_en: In a university chemistry laboratory, the female graduate student turns to the young male student and asks him a question.
shots.narration: 小研问阿杰：现在着火了，你怎么办？

shots.scene: 阿杰愣住，左顾右盼
shots.prompt_en: The young male student freezes and looks around the lab nervously, scratching his head.
shots.narration: 阿杰愣住了，灭火器在哪都不知道。

shots.scene: 阿杰想打电话，却不知道打给谁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds up his phone, confused, with a question mark over the screen.
shots.narration: 该打给谁？电话号码也不知道。

shots.scene: 小研带他走到门口的应急信息板前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leads him to a blank emergency information board beside the lab door.
shots.narration: 小研笑笑：这些，进门第一天就要会。

shots.scene: 设备冒烟、突然停电、瓶子打翻三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a smoking instrument, a dark room after a power cut and a tipped bottle. No text.
shots.narration: 设备故障、停电、打翻，谁都可能遇到。

shots.scene: 预防盾牌和应急箱并排
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shield icon for prevention next to an emergency kit icon, joined by a plus sign. No text.
shots.narration: 预防做得再好，也要有应急准备。

shots.scene: 动手前想一想：可能出什么错
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student with a thought bubble showing a small fire, a spill and a cut finger before starting work. No text.
shots.narration: 动手前先想：可能出什么错？

shots.scene: 每个错误旁配一个应对办法
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: each problem icon connected by an arrow to a matching response icon, a fire extinguisher, a spill kit and a bandage. No text.
shots.narration: 想好了，就提前备好应对办法。

shots.scene: 慌乱的人打叉，冷静的人点头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a panicking person crossed out next to a calm person nodding with a checklist. No text.
shots.narration: 事故来时没时间准备，准备好才不慌。

shots.scene: 法律书本和预案手册
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thick blank law book and a blank emergency plan binder side by side, a balance scale icon. No text.
shots.narration: 法律要求单位制定应急预案。

shots.scene: 三层金字塔：学校、学院、实验室
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a three-level pyramid with a campus building on top, a college building in the middle and a laboratory at the bottom. No text.
shots.narration: 学校、学院、实验室，三级预案。

shots.scene: 学校总预案：组织指挥、调动力量
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a campus command center icon with arrows reaching to fire, medical and security icons. No text.
shots.narration: 学校总体预案，管组织指挥和联动。

shots.scene: 学院专项预案：本院的主要风险
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a college building with several hazard icons, flame, flask, biohazard and radiation, each with a plan card. No text.
shots.narration: 学院针对本院风险，定专项预案。

shots.scene: 实验室现场处置方案贴在门口
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laboratory door with a small step-by-step response card posted beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室有现场处置方案，最具体。

shots.scene: 三级预案之间连线衔接
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three plan binders linked by arrows, the lab plan passing a message up to college and campus. No text.
shots.narration: 三级衔接，现场处置不了就逐级上报。

shots.scene: 老周对着本室危害清单写预案
shots.prompt_en: The older man sits at a desk writing a blank response plan beside a hazard list with lab icons.
shots.narration: 预案要针对本实验室的具体危害。

shots.scene: 着火、溢洒、受伤三张处置卡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three blank response cards with a flame icon, a spill icon and an injured hand icon, each with numbered steps. No text.
shots.narration: 着火、溢洒、受伤，各怎么办写清楚。

shots.scene: 停电、设备停机、暴雨三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a power cut, an instrument suddenly stopping with a warning mark, and a heavy rainstorm. No text.
shots.narration: 停电、设备突然停机、恶劣天气也要想。

shots.scene: 设备停机后会不会泄漏、升温
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stopped instrument with two question marks, one for a leak and one for rising heat. No text.
shots.narration: 停机会不会泄漏、有没有新风险？

shots.scene: 不同化学品各有一张应对卡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: several different reagent bottles, each linked to its own small response card. No text.
shots.narration: 物料不同，出事方式不同，逐一想好。

shots.scene: 压力容器泄压口和通风柜在应急时工作
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pressure vessel with a relief valve and a running fume hood with airflow arrows during an alarm. No text.
shots.narration: 压力容器能泄压，紧急时能通风。

shots.scene: 应急组织图：总指挥、联络、疏散、救护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an emergency team chart with a leader icon on top and branches for phone call, evacuation guide and first aid helper. No text.
shots.narration: 预案里写清应急组织和分工。

shots.scene: 老周是实验室应急第一负责人
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands in front of his laboratory, holding a blank plan binder, with a leader badge icon.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人，是第一责任人。

shots.scene: 小研负责报警联络，王老师负责协调
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a phone while the safety administrator directs with a raised hand.
shots.narration: 谁报警、谁疏散、谁救护，事先分好。

shots.scene: 阿杰指着自己：我负责什么
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at himself and looks at a blank role card in his hand.
shots.narration: 每个人都要知道，出事时自己做什么。

shots.scene: 负责人不在，替补顶上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a leader icon marked absent and an arrow passing the leader badge to a deputy. No text.
shots.narration: 负责人不在时，由谁接替也要明确。

shots.section_title: 应急电话和处置卡上墙
shots.scene: 【实拍】实验室门口张贴的应急联系卡（近景）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a blank emergency contact card posted on a laboratory door with telephone icons and empty lines.
shots.narration: 门口贴好应急联系卡。
overlay: 应急电话和处置卡上墙

shots.section_title: 应急电话和处置卡上墙
shots.scene: 联系卡上的电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a contact card with a fire truck icon, an ambulance icon, a police icon and a campus security icon, each beside a phone icon. No text.
shots.narration: 119、120、110，还有保卫处值班电话。

shots.section_title: 应急电话和处置卡上墙
shots.scene: 实验室负责人和安全员的手机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two person icons for the lab leader and the safety officer, each with a mobile phone icon. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人、安全员的手机也写上。

shots.section_title: 应急电话和处置卡上墙
shots.scene: 阿杰把电话存进手机
shots.prompt_en: The young male student saves the numbers from the board into his phone.
shots.narration: 把这些电话存进手机。

shots.section_title: 应急电话和处置卡上墙
shots.scene: 【实拍】墙上的处置流程卡近景
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a blank laminated response flow card on a laboratory wall with numbered step icons.
shots.narration: 关键处置步骤做成卡片，贴在现场。

shots.section_title: 应急电话和处置卡上墙
shots.scene: 号码换了，卡片及时更新
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an old contact card crossed out and a new card replacing it, a calendar icon. No text.
shots.narration: 人员和号码变了，及时更新。

shots.scene: 四张资源卡并排
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four blank resource cards in a row with icons, a data sheet, a rule book, a plan binder and an emergency kit. No text.
shots.narration: 应急要用的资源，平时就备好。

shots.scene: 翻开安全技术说明书的急救和泄漏部分
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an open safety data sheet with first aid, spill and firefighting section icons highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 安全技术说明书：急救、泄漏、灭火都有。

shots.scene: 说明书放在顺手的地方
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a folder of safety data sheets on a shelf beside the lab door, within easy reach. No text.
shots.narration: 放在顺手处，用之前先查。

shots.scene: 管理制度和操作规程
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a binder of lab rules and standard procedures with an exposure response page marked. No text.
shots.narration: 制度和规程，含暴露后怎么处置。

shots.scene: 应急预案是最重要的一件
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the plan binder raised above the other cards with a star icon. No text.
shots.narration: 最重要的是应急预案，要读懂。

shots.scene: 应急物资就在手边
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fire extinguisher, an eyewash station, a spill kit and a first aid kit placed near the lab door. No text.
shots.narration: 还要有应急物资，伸手可及。

shots.section_title: 应急物资定点放定期查
shots.scene: 灭火器、洗眼器、喷淋、溢洒包、急救箱定点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lab floor plan with fixed spots for a fire extinguisher, an eyewash station, a safety shower, a spill kit and a first aid kit. No text.
shots.narration: 物资定点放好，人人知道在哪。
overlay: 应急物资定点放定期查

shots.section_title: 应急物资定点放定期查
shots.scene: 物资按本室风险配置
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chemistry lab with a spill kit, a biology lab with a biohazard spill kit and a cylinder room with a gas detector. No text.
shots.narration: 按本室风险配，重点区域配齐。

shots.section_title: 应急物资定点放定期查
shots.scene: 【实拍】打开应急物资箱，逐项清点
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands open an emergency supply box and check items one by one against a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 定期清点，对照清单逐项查。

shots.section_title: 应急物资定点放定期查
shots.scene: 过期物品拿出来，换上新的
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an expired item with a calendar mark taken out of a box and a new item put in. No text.
shots.narration: 过期的、用掉的，及时补换。

shots.section_title: 应急物资定点放定期查
shots.scene: 灭火器前堆着纸箱，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: cardboard boxes piled in front of a fire extinguisher and an eyewash station, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 物资前不堆东西，不挪作他用。

shots.section_title: 应急物资定点放定期查
shots.scene: 两条撤离路线箭头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lab floor plan with two green arrows leading to two different exits and an emergency exit sign. No text.
shots.narration: 记住两条撤离路线。

shots.section_title: 应急物资定点放定期查
shots.scene: 检查记录本签名
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student signs a blank inspection log beside the emergency supply box.
shots.narration: 检查要记录，发现问题马上报。

shots.scene: 预案手册落灰躺在架子上，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dusty emergency plan binder lying forgotten on a high shelf, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 预案放在架上落灰，关键时刻没用。

shots.scene: 王老师给大家培训
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator trains a small group of students in a classroom, pointing at a blank board with emergency icons.
shots.narration: 人人参加培训，学会应急程序。

shots.scene: 演练：大家按分工行动
shots.prompt_en: Students and the older man take part in a laboratory drill, one calling, one guiding others out, one holding a first aid kit.
shots.narration: 定期演练，按分工动起来。

shots.scene: 演练时有人嘻嘻哈哈，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student laughing and strolling slowly during a drill, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 演练要当真，不走过场。

shots.scene: 演练中顺便找到洗眼器和灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at an eyewash station and a fire extinguisher during the drill.
shots.narration: 演练时记住洗眼器、灭火器在哪。

shots.scene: 演练后围坐总结，改预案
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the safety administrator and the students sit around a table reviewing the drill and marking a plan binder.
shots.narration: 演练后总结，发现问题就改预案。

shots.scene: 反复练习，动作变成习惯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a repeating circular arrow around a person whose emergency steps become automatic, a brain with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 反复练，临场才能不慌。

shots.scene: 红色警报灯闪烁，人先撤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flashing red alarm light in a lab and people walking quickly toward the exit. No text.
shots.narration: 出了事，人命第一，财物第二。

shots.scene: 顺手关掉热源和气阀
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand turning off a heating plate switch and closing a gas valve in one quick motion. No text.
shots.narration: 几秒能做到的，顺手关热源和气源。

shots.scene: 火势逼近，放弃关阀直接撤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a growing fire near a valve, a person turning away from it and leaving, with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 做不到就别管，立即撤离。

shots.scene: 冲进烟雾救人，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person rushing into smoke without protection to pull someone out, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 救人前，先保证自己安全。

shots.scene: 撤出后回去拿电脑，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person going back into a lab for a laptop after evacuating, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 撤出后，不回去拿东西。

shots.scene: 负责人组织撤离，关门
shots.prompt_en: The older man guides students out of the lab and closes the door behind them.
shots.narration: 负责人立即组织撤离，随手关门。

shots.scene: 深呼吸，保持冷静
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person taking a deep breath with a calm wave icon, a panicking crowd crossed out beside. No text.
shots.narration: 保持冷静，慌乱只会添乱。

shots.scene: 四个图标：碎玻璃、溅身、洒漏、着火
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, broken glass, a splash on a sleeve, a spill on a bench and a small flame. No text.
shots.narration: 碎玻璃、溅身上、洒漏、着火……

shots.scene: 阿杰马上告诉老周
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hurries to the older man and points back at a spill on the bench.
shots.narration: 不管哪种，第一时间告诉老师。

shots.scene: 自己乱擦乱倒，冒出烟雾，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person wiping a spill with paper and pouring water on it, fumes rising, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别自己乱处理，可能引发危险反应。

shots.scene: 按指示一起清理
shots.prompt_en: The older man instructs, and the young male student and the female graduate student clean up a small spill together with gloves and a spill kit.
shots.narration: 按负责人指示，安全地一起处理。

shots.scene: 有人受伤，先处置，再报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: first an injured hand being rinsed, then an arrow to a phone call to the supervisor. No text.
shots.narration: 有人受伤先救护，同时报告。

shots.scene: 三级预案金字塔和联系卡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a three-level pyramid next to a contact card posted on a door. No text.
shots.narration: 三级预案，分工明确，电话上墙。

shots.scene: 物资箱和演练
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an emergency supply box with a check mark and a group doing a drill. No text.
shots.narration: 物资定点定期查，演练要当真。

shots.scene: 人形图标在最前，后面是报告箭头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person icon with a shield in front, followed by an arrow to a phone icon. No text.
shots.narration: 人命优先，先保自己，及时报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着手电筒站在一片漆黑里
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a flashlight in a dark laboratory, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：停电停水等公用设施中断。
